name: witnessd
description: Teaches Claude when to get tamper-evident, third-party evidence of what a public URL or API returned, and connects the witnessd MCP server ($0.02 per snapshot via x402 USDC on Base, Merkle-anchored on-chain, verifiable by anyone).

evm_private_key.title: Wallet private key (USDC on Base)
evm_private_key.description: Key of a SMALL dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base. Used only to pay witnessd per call ($0.02 witness, $0.05 retrieve). Leave empty if you use an API key instead, or for free certificate lookups only.

witnessd_api_key.title: witnessd API key (optional alternative)
witnessd_api_key.description: Prepaid witnessd credit key (starts with wk_). Use this OR the wallet key. Leave empty if unused.
